title: Your Phone Motion Sensor Is a Hidden Spy

vo.en: Stop typing until you flip your phone.

visual.description: A close-up of a man's hand rotating a smartphone from vertical to horizontal orientation.

vo.en: Your phone’s motion sensors are leaking your private data every single time you tilt the screen.

visual.description: Abstract blue and yellow data streams flowing rapidly across a dark background.

vo.en: Hackers use your accelerometer to measure the tiny vibrations made by your fingers as you type.

visual.description: Extreme close-up of male fingers tapping rapidly on a smartphone keyboard.

vo.en: Wait until you see the creepy part: they can reconstruct your passwords with eighty percent accuracy.

visual.description: A silhouette of a man in a dark room illuminated only by the glow of a computer screen.

vo.en: Rotate your phone sideways right now. That movement is exactly how they map your keyboard.

visual.description: An oscilloscope showing green sound waves or vibration patterns moving across a grid.

vo.en: Most mobile browsers give websites full access to these sensors without ever asking your permission.

visual.description: A digital padlock icon on a screen flickering red as it is bypassed.
